abstract: A 51-year-old woman presented with a 2-month history of intermittent cough and precordial chest pain associated with shortness of breath. Initial chest-x-ray revealed a large well-circumscribed mass in the left perihilar region and consolidation of left lower lobe. Computed tomography scan of the chest revealed a large irregular fluid-filled mass occupying the left hemithorax, causing a mediastinal shift to the right, and a left pleural effusion. A pigtail was inserted; pleural fluid was exudative without evidence of malignant cells. Left thoracotomy revealed an anterior mediastinal mass of 20 cm in diameter adherent to the pericardium, pleura, and lung. Pathologic examination showed a variety of cell lines consisting of respiratory mucosa, mucous glands, cartilage, smooth muscle, adipose tissue, and pancreatic tissue, results consistent with a mature teratoma. Mature cystic teratomas are usually benign in nature and represent 60% to 70% of mediastinal germ cell tumors; they are found most commonly in young adults. The anterior mediastinum is the most common site for these types of tumors. Rupture of a mediastinal cystic teratoma is a rare event and can be a life-threatening condition. The treatment is mainly surgical, with an excellent prognosis such as in our patient.
abstract_ja: 51歳女性が2か月間続く間欠的な咳嗽と前胸部痛、息切れを主訴に来院した。初回の胸部X線で左肺門部の境界明瞭な大きな腫瘤と左下葉の浸潤影を認めた。胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では、左半胸郭を占める大きな不整な液体貯留性腫瘤があり、縦隔は右方へ偏位し、左胸水を伴っていた。ピッグテールカテーテルを挿入したところ、胸水は滲出性で悪性細胞は認めなかった。左開胸術で、心膜・胸膜・肺に癒着した直径20cmの前縦隔腫瘤を認めた。病理学的検査では、呼吸器粘膜、粘液腺、軟骨、平滑筋、脂肪組織、膵組織からなる多様な細胞系譜を認め、成熟奇形腫に合致した。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は通常良性で、縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍の60〜70%を占め、若年成人に最も多い。前縦隔は最も好発部位である。嚢胞性奇形腫の破裂は稀だが生命を脅かしうる。治療は主に外科的切除で、本症例と同様に予後は良好である。
